title: Contact Us
description: Contact The Daily Meridian newsroom, submit a correction, or get in touch about advertising and partnerships.

body.html: Demonstration website. Replace the contact details below with your organisation's real address and email before launch. This site has no backend, so contact is by email.

body: For news tips, story ideas and press enquiries: newsroom@example.com
If you believe we have published an error, please email corrections@example.com with the article URL and a description of the issue. See our Corrections Policy.
To exercise your data protection rights, email privacy@example.com. See our Privacy Policy.
